scope: Complete CPU OutputParser only; no real model or HTTP performance measurement

environment.simd: SSE2, direct Python 1/2/4-byte Unicode, bounded 16-byte loads

notes: Negative elapsed change means faster. Reject absolute A drift >3%.
Plain reasoning had a +24.08% outlier; pinned rerun did not reproduce it; no gain/no-regression conclusion for ordinary text.
Regex remains in Python fallback and literal prompt marker restoration.
Native extension is optional; the current machine has built it. Other platforms/Python versions have not been build-tested.

timing.json.scope: CPU complete OutputParser; equivalent outputs; last verified parser versus single-run Python fast path and optional native SSE2 scans
timing.json.method: same process A/B/A, 7 samples per arm, median B versus geometric mean of A medians; reject >3% baseline drift
